verdict.rationale: Green & Spiegel is an immigration law firm offering legal consultation and application services, not a software product holding user data. In-product AI-generated insights from a user's data is a category error for this kind of offering. The evidence shows no software product, client portal, or AI feature that would make the axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
